_comment: Paste these two blocks into the `hooks` object of ~/.claude/settings.json
SessionStart: matcher 'startup|resume|clear' — the three sources that can
leave a session unarmed. 'compact' is excluded (same sid, same process,
the arm survives) and 'fork' is excluded conservatively. An entry with no
matcher runs on EVERY source, which is not what we want here.
async:true means the hook does not hold up the session; timeout 15 is a
ceiling we never approach because the hook detaches and returns.
Stop: no matcher — it fires on every completed turn. The re-arm hook rides
an async entry so a slow self-heal can never delay the next prompt.
Paths use ~ so they work regardless of username. If you keep the scripts
elsewhere, set KEEPWARM_CTL in your environment instead of editing these.
